leadText: Volume 4: Friends and Families is the fourth of ten volumes of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino.
plainText:
Volume 4: Friends and Families is the fourth of ten volumes of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino.

==Blurb==
SISTERS?! OH, BROTHER!
Almond and Hazel go to 's house to meet Squirtle's five sisters, but the Squirtle household has a terrifying surprise for our heroes!
When Almond is in the hospital, Hazel buys flowers from Peanut's amorous florist brother Pistachio.
Hazel shrinks to a size only inches tall! Now how will she get Almond to notice her?!
A game of hide and seek goes terribly wrong for Peanut and . Can the weakest human and most timid Pokémon survive in a cruel world?
These stories and many, many more!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
The Five Sisters of Squirtle
Green-Eyed Bulbasaur
Follow that Love Potion!
Pidgeot Loves Pidgetta
Hazel's Big Adventure!
Charmander's Boring, Boring Day
The Unbearable Suspense of Hide-and-Seek!
The Unbearable Suspense of... THE GHOSTSTORY!!! (BOO!)
Wal's Present

==Important events==
Pistachio and his are introduced.
and Bulbasaur have their first battle.
Peanut, , and meet again through a cave connected to where the Stone of Adventure was located.

==Trivia==
In the Pokémon File at the end of this volume, which also appears in Pokémon Sleepover, is identified with the nickname "Bulba." Despite this, she is never referred to with a nickname in the English translation by any characters in the regular manga pages.
At the end of the book, there is a joke advertisement for teasing that and will get married, prompting Almond to discover who he has feelings for.
